title: 3. A resistência e a manipulação das correntes

queries.text: "recordação de si" rendered as "self-remembering," the established English term from Gurdjieff. Proposed for the glossary.

"simpatizar ou antipatizar com o outro" literally means "to feel sympathy or antipathy toward the other"; the context (behaving in a chosen way) suggests the ability to create sympathy or antipathy at will. Rendered as "to win the other's sympathy or antipathy"; alternative: "to be in sympathy or antipathy with the other."
"um espelho que refrata os feitiços": a mirror reflects rather than refracts; the author may have meant "reflete." Kept "refracts" to preserve the original; consider "reflects."
